name: What is involved in a shower removal project?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a shower removal project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shower removal typically involves disconnecting plumbing, carefully demolishing the existing shower unit, removing debris, and preparing the area for a new installation or other bathroom renovations. The scope can vary based on the shower type (e.g., walk-in, stall, or tub-shower combo) and the surrounding wall materials. Proper protection of the rest of the bathroom is also a key part of the process to minimize dust and damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Shower removal involves disconnecting plumbing, demolition, debris removal, and preparing the space for a new installation.
